faq.q: Do I need a photo of the packaging?
faq.a: No. Start with a clear product photo and describe the package style you want to show.

faq.q: Can I make a gift set reveal?
faq.a: Yes. Describe the set and its main pieces, then keep the first reveal focused on the item shoppers need to see.

faq.q: What video lengths can I choose?
Can I use the clip on a product page?
faq.a: Yes. Download the clip and place it on your store page or in a social ad, then follow the channel rules.

faq.q: Will logos and printed words render correctly?
faq.a: AI lettering can vary. Add final brand text in your editor after download.

faq.q: How many credits does an unboxing video use?
faq.a: A 6-second video uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60 and 30 seconds uses 120. Failed jobs return credits automatically.

faq.q: Can I use the clip for paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Review the result, add your campaign text in an editor and follow the platform rules before launch.
